title: Unravelling ammonium and nitrate dynamics in soils: effects of soil type, moisture content, and temperature revealed by diffusive gradients in thin-films
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00994D, Paper
Krishantha Kodithuwakku, Jianyin Huang, Casey L. Doolette, Sean Mason, Orlando Lam-Gordillo, Enzo Lombi, Niklas J. Lehto
This study uniquely reveals soil temperature-moisture effects on NH4+ and NO3− dynamics using diffusive gradients in thin-films (DGT).
